items.question: Which mantra syllables constitute the primordial vidyā rooted in Śambhavī?
premises: The mantra syllables given are svāhā, hsau, and hsau.
This sequence is identified as a specific vidyā.
The vidyā is characterized as rooted in Śambhavī and primordial.
items.inference: The sequence svāhā hsau hsau constitutes the primordial Śambhavī-root vidyā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of śambhavīmūla within this Śrīvidyā context is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Svāhā, hsau, hsau — this is the primordial vidyā rooted in Śambhavī.
